source: native_boot.js shopPolicy and original Data tables

dragonEgg.withinTier: uniform among first matching color on each original hero upgrade chain
dragonEgg.pityScope: all non-tutorial shop and inventory egg draws; counts persist when dismissed
dragonEgg.tripleGuarantee: if first two and third rolls are lowest tier, upgrade third to middle tier
dragonEgg.tutorial: preserve prior one-time user-authorized level-30 elf

rpc_s_dismiss_drawcard.response: stock UI closes dismissed card; local wallet synchronized

treasure.content: original item_getAfterUse -> input_event_client -> resource_input / item_input; rebirth overrides in rebirth-treasure.json; hero treasure overrides in hero-treasure.json
treasure.heroBalance: hero-treasure.json; item 1501/1502/1503 only; fragment quantities doubled; wanted/crystal stages use independent fixed probabilities instead of original window/cap/security
treasure.rebirthBalance: rebirth-treasure.json; item 1504/1505/1506 only; overrides stageSelection and quantity at named fragment/blueprint stages
treasure.stageSelection: one resource alternative and one item alternative per chain node, uniform when no stage weights exist
treasure.itemWeights: normalize original item_random_chance weights; do not treat raw weights as percentages
treasure.quantity: fixed item_num or inclusive uniform original item_random_numRange
treasure.emptyNode: item_id=0 and empty random pool yields no item
treasure.limitPolicy: interpret item_random_useLimit=[window,cap] as per-event attempt window; base success cap/window; at most cap wins in window
treasure.securityPolicy: item_random_security-th consecutive attempt guarantees success if window cap allows; counters persist
treasure.inventoryEgg: item 1124 consumes one item, opens same persistent dragon egg session

persistence.payment: snapshot ResourceManager after stock useRes; no second debit
persistence.commit: detached transaction writes payment/results/counters before stock callback
persistence.resume: persist pending cards before display; re-open pending session without new payment
persistence.claim: persist heroes and terminal card statuses before applying stock response; duplicate claim cannot grant twice
persistence.failure: reject invalid/missing config, full bag or disk write; synchronize wallet/package/counters from last saved transaction
persistence.protected: account XP, level, guide state, existing heroes, receipts, inventory
